card.name: Sports rankings and best-player phrases
card.fires_on: Words inside sports text about rankings, best players or league standings, such as "best southpaw in the league" or a goalkeeper poll. It also fires on nearby words like "by the end of May".

modes.label: Best-in-league phrasing
modes.description: Small words following a claim that a player is the best in a league, and the time phrase after it.
modes.example: The article predicted that he would be the best southpaw<< in>> the league by the end of May.

modes.label: Sports polls and categories
modes.description: Words in ranking lists or athlete classification text.
modes.example: the top 20 goalkeepers on the IFFHS<< poll>> for "The World's best Goalkeeper
